description: Convert between fitness data formats (FIT, TCX, ZWO, GCN, KRD). FIT output is returned as base64 text unless output_file is given.

ftp.description: Athlete FTP in watts. Required for GCN output when the workout has %FTP power targets (resolved to watts)

input_content.description: Inline content (text or base64 for binary)

output_file.description: Path to write output (FIT is returned as base64 when omitted)

name: kaiord_convert
